children: SunPower entered into securities purchase agreements with accredited investors for a private placement of 103,109,005 common shares at $0.2541 per share, raising approximately $26.2 million. The company expects the transaction to close on Sep 4, 2026 and will use proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. SunPower agreed to file a resale registration statement for the shares by Oct 2, 2026.
: Securities purchase agreements for private placement of common stock
: Various accredited investors, including affiliates of T.J. Rodgers, William Anderson, J. Daniel McCranie and Devin Whatley
: Bolster liquidity for working capital and corporate needs
